note: This file is a pure configuration dictionary (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines model settings for an FPN + ResNet-50 EncoderDecoder used in MMSegmentation semantic segmentation tasks.
summarize_model_config: summarize the FPN ResNet50 encoder-decoder model configuration for semantic segmentation
review_norm_cfg: review the SyncBN normalization configuration used across backbone and decode head
review_data_preprocessor: review the SegDataPreProcessor settings including mean std and bgr_to_rgb conversion
review_backbone_config: review the ResNetV1c backbone configuration with depth 50 and four output stages
review_decode_head_config: review the FPNHead decode head configuration with 19 classes and cross-entropy loss
